title: Ubik
author: Philip K. Dick
summary: In a 1992 where psychics are hired and the dead can be kept in cold-sleep, technician Joe Chip and his boss Glen Runciter are caught in a trap on the Moon. Afterwards, reality itself begins to decay around Joe.
readIf: you like paranoid, slippery 1960s science fiction that questions what is real.
skipIf: you want tidy worldbuilding and answers explained plainly.
